PROP-current-fina-inv-036.text: Protocol must prevent cToken inflation attack where first depositor manipulates exchange rate.
PROP-current-fina-inv-036.assertion: forall first_deposit(amount): ctokens_minted > min_liquidity_threshold AND forall subsequent_deposit(amt2): ctokens_minted2 > 0

locations.note: Computes mint_amount via float::int_div(collateral_amount, exchange_rate()); when total_supply==0 exchange_rate==1:1
Returns 1:1 when total_supply==0; after donation attack exchange rate inflates causing near-zero ctokens for subsequent depositors
